title: Kelleran Beq
subtitle: Where are the Others?
text:
Ambush
This unit gets +1/+0 for each other unit (friendly and enemy) with 0 power.
rules:
Ambush is an ability that triggers at the same time as “When Played” abilities. The unit does not have to be ready in order to attack.
Abilities that refer to a card’s power include temporary modifiers. Power cannot be reduced below 0.
